caption: The drawing depicts a large wooden cabinet with a rectangular shape and prominent, intricate paneling on its two doors. The cabinet is colored in various shades of brown, mimicking the natural appearance of wood grain. The top of the cabinet is wide and features a pronounced, layered cornice that projects outward. The two main doors are elaborately framed with multiple nested rectangular panels, each bordered by beveled edges and set in symmetrical alignment. Below the doors, the cabinet has a base with two drawers, each also bordered with rectangular panels and featuring a single knob in the center. Geometric diamond shapes accentuate the areas beside the drawers. The cabinet stands on four legs, with the two front legs being spherical and bulbous, while the back legs are straight and less ornate. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or decorative elements. There are small, handwritten notations in the bottom right corner.
title: Kas
